name: OmarchWeb
author: giodc
description: Web development control panel: start/stop/restart PHP-FPM, MariaDB, Nginx, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Mailpit; create/delete databases and app users; add PHP, Laravel, WordPress, or Node virtual hosts — from a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: Start/stop web services, manage databases, add virtual hosts

schema.label: Status refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-check running services and database list while the panel is open.

schema.label: Web root
schema.description: Base folder where new virtual hosts and projects are created.

schema.label: Nginx listen port
schema.description: Port that generated virtual hosts listen on.
